title: Semi-glossy
identify: Light reflections have less defined edges.
recognition: Moderate shine without a strong mirror effect.

confused_with.difference: Glossy: sharp bright reflections; semi-glossy: softer highlights.
Satin: broad gentle sheen, no mirror-like reflection.
